recipes.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+3 and has deathtouch. (Any amount of damage it deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)

recipe_coverage: Reviewed continuous Aura component: normal casting and target loss, persistence through cleanup, legal Disenchant removal and Disperse bounce, attached-host bounce/destruction, owner-specific zones, exact costs, snapshot/AI replay, and declared keywords through real combat. Declared entry draw/life effects and Aura-to-hand death replacements are checked. Activated abilities, alternate costs, graveyard return abilities, dredge, madness, cycling, aura swap, and granted activated abilities remain separate coverage gaps where present. Not whole-card certification.
